WITH matched AS (
  SELECT il.order_item_id, p.product_color, il.product_quantity,
         il.derived_product_cost, il.derived_total_cost
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS il
  JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = il.order_item_id
  JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, product_color,
         AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_units_invoiced,
         AVG(
           (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)
         ) AS average_calculated_ratio
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY order_item_id, product_color
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT order_item_id, product_color, average_units_invoiced,
         average_calculated_ratio,
         RANK() OVER (
           PARTITION BY product_color
           ORDER BY average_units_invoiced DESC NULLS LAST
         ) AS rank
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT order_item_id, product_color, average_units_invoiced,
       average_calculated_ratio, rank
FROM ranked
WHERE rank <= 3
ORDER BY order_item_id, product_color, average_units_invoiced, average_calculated_ratio, rank
